{{Quote|Choose from multiple tea varieties imported from across the galaxy, from scry-mint to Roonan lemon. Zingbee honey and Christophsian sugar available upon request.|Dex's Diner menu, on its stim tea|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Zingbee honey''' was variety of [[Honey/Legends|honey]] made by [[Zingbee]]s, a type of creature that were eaten by members of the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Customers at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] could request zingbee honey for their [[stim tea]]<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zingbee honey was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
